review_question: Does the archived CDPRM S1, R16, and closed R5-R13 selector/critic evidence justify a falsifiable orthogonal research program for one official-ConvIR-B-only continuous bounded regional modulation definition whose sole first operation is a protected-data-free no-data S0 architecture qualification?

candidate_program.core_hypothesis: A single internal official-ConvIR-B module can represent spatially varying restoration demand and conservative protection as continuous bounded fields and apply a zero-initialized residual modulation without selecting among candidate restoration actions.
candidate_program.required_form: F_out = F + gamma(x, F) * DeltaF, with gamma spatial, continuous, explicitly bounded, and initialized so the complete module is an exact no-op.
fixed_constraints: Use the immutable official ConvIR-B architecture anchor and official checkpoint as baseline and initialization only.
Use exactly one preregistered insertion location inside ConvIR-B; insertion location is not a search dimension.
Do not depend on WDMamba at inference, training, supervision, action definition, or module construction.
Do not construct candidate actions and do not use a selector, critic, abstention gate, coverage threshold, or risk threshold.
Represent demand as a continuous signed or nonnegative bounded modulation pressure, not a binary demand mask.
Represent protection as continuous attenuation of permitted modulation magnitude, not a binary protection or safe-mask class.

Do not expose GT-derived demand, protection, or safe masks as runtime inputs. Future supervision, if ever authorized, must be separately frozen and cannot silently restore the failed hard-label definitions.
Initialize the new residual/modulation path to exact identity behavior and require official checkpoint tensors to load with exact key and shape identity.
Permit missing checkpoint keys only under one declared RDPCM module prefix; permit no unexpected keys and no shape mismatch for official tensors.

The schema-1 S0 spec must freeze the exact insertion layer, module width and depth, bounded function and numeric bounds, initialization constants, parameter and memory limits, numerical no-op tolerance, and gradient-reachability procedure before S0; do not search them after observing S0 or later scientific results.

orthogonal_dimensions.change: Replace discrete candidate-action selection and abstention with direct continuous bounded feature modulation.
Replace the ConvIR-B/WDMamba compound action system with one official-ConvIR-B-only internal module.
Replace unstable hard demand/protection/safe labels with continuous bounded demand pressure and conservative protection attenuation.
Move from post-hoc regional endpoint actions to one fixed internal ConvIR-B feature intervention.

criterion_findings.finding: CONVIR_ONLY_RDPCM_V1 has no candidate bank, selector, critic, coverage rule, abstention decision, or WDMamba dependency. It shares only the broad regional-heterogeneity question with R5-R13, not the closed family's core action-selection assumption. It is therefore orthogonal, not a reopen or adjacent retune.

R16 retained privileged regional headroom of +0.123429 dB with LCB95 +0.065142, and CDPRM S1 retained +0.130810 dB with LCB95 +0.101135. CDPRM spatial specificity and regional specificity passed, while adaptive regions did not improve over fixed 8x8 (point +0.000366 dB, LCB95 -0.001028). This supports testing one fixed-location continuous modulation mechanism, but does not establish learnability, deployability, or module effectiveness.

Demand stability passed (Jaccard LCB95 0.719426), but protection and safe-mask stability failed (LCB95 0.652540 and 0.587259). The accepted definition therefore prohibits hard demand/protection/safe classes and thresholds. Demand and protection are continuous modulation semantics; future target/loss definitions remain unauthorized until separately frozen.

One fixed insertion point plus an official ConvIR-B baseline and a parameter/compute-matched global-uniform modulation control can distinguish spatial variation from added parameters and nonlinear capacity, provided all three arms share the same checkpoint, initialization, trainable scope, optimizer, schedule, data, seeds, and budget. S0 does not make this scientific comparison.

This review authorizes creation of a closeable CONVIR_ONLY_RDPCM_V1 definition; it is not yet the fully frozen object. The schema-1 S0 spec must freeze its insertion point, module form, bounds, initialization, width/depth, resource limits, no-op tolerance, gradient procedure, controls, and later discrimination contrast before evidence. Only then can a future valid scientific FAIL close that exact definition and forbid position, width, depth, seed, learning-rate, threshold, or loss-weight rescue. A no-data S0 engineering failure is not scientific evidence and permits only the bounded same-contract repair policy.

The program retains a later independent real non-uniform-haze validation stage, but only after S0 and a separately frozen development discrimination stage. NH-HAZE 01-50 remain training-overlap development evidence; NH-HAZE 51-55, Haze4K locked test, confirmation, canary, and locked-test roles remain sealed and are not authorized by this review.

After GitHub activation, the sole next action is authoring and statically validating a protected-data-free synthetic/no-data S0 route. S0 execution remains unauthorized until the frozen schema-1 spec, compiled schema-6 bundle, route-ready gate, route commit/push, and MCP plan identities all match. This review authorizes no training, scientific data access, effectiveness claim, candidate comparison, confirmation, canary, locked test, or external validation.
